articles.title: Landlords selling short-lease flats face huge losses
articles.summary: If you're selling do you extend at a cost or sell at a loss?
articles.ai_summary:

- The dilemma highlights the challenging market conditions for landlords, as extending leases may not be a viable solution amid declining property values.

articles.title: Worst yields for landlords – locations with relatively poor returns
articles.summary: A new analysis of Zoopla data shows the lowest-yielding locations in the UK for buy to let landlords. Cambridge has the lowest average gross yield across major cities at 4.7%, despite monthly rents costing more than £500 less than in London on average.  London headlines the list, with gross yields of 5.1% on average – […]
articles.ai_summary:
- A Zoopla analysis reveals Cambridge offers the lowest average gross yield for landlords at 4.7%, significantly lower than London's 5.1%, despite cheaper rents.  
- Across major cities, landlords in these low-yield areas face challenges, making investment less attractive despite high demand.
